tape-obsession-2025.title: Obsession
tape-obsession-2025.description: A lovesick young man breaks a novelty “One Wish Willow” to make the girl he likes fall for him, and gets a devotion far more frightening than heartbreak.

tape-the-nun-2018.title: The Nun
tape-the-nun-2018.description: In 1952 the Vatican sends a haunted priest and a young novice to a remote Romanian abbey after a nun takes her own life there, and they find the demon Valak waiting.
